paper_title: Automatic Task Detection and Heterogeneous LLM Speculative Decoding
caption: The word "reaction" tends to co-occur with different tokens in the domains of chemistry (a) and mathematics (b).

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The diagrams compare the distribution of certain tokens co-occurring with the word "reaction" in the domains of chemistry and mathematics, with diagram (a) representing chemistry and diagram (b) representing mathematics. Diagram (a) is divided into five sectors, labeled as "the", "this", "for", "chemical", and "in", with percentages of 31%, 21%, 17%, 15%, and 7% respectively, and featuring different colors and patterns, including blue diagonal stripes, blue horizontal stripes, green checkered, yellow wavy lines, and blue vertical stripes. Diagram (b) is divided into four sectors, labeled as "the", "$", "equilibrium", and "consatant", with percentages of 38%, 27%, 19%, and 15% respectively, and featuring different colors and patterns, including blue diagonal stripes, red dots, yellow dots, and grey solid color. Both diagrams include a legend that explains the color and pattern coding for each sector, and the percentages are labeled within or near their respective sectors, with no sector being visually emphasized or offset from the others.
model_annotations.English: The two pie charts compare the relative frequencies of certain tokens co-occurring with the word "reaction" in the domains of chemistry and mathematics. Chart (a) has five slices, with "the" in blue diagonal stripes making up 31%, "this" in horizontal blue stripes making up 21%, "for" in a green crisscross pattern making up 17%, "chemical" in yellow texture making up 15%, and "in" in blue vertical stripes making up 7% or 9%. The chart includes a legend that matches the labels to their corresponding colors and patterns, and percentage labels are placed directly on the slices. Chart (b) has four slices, with "the" in blue diagonal stripes making up 38%, an unspecified token "$" in red dots making up 27%, "equilibrium" in yellow dots making up 19%, and "constant" in grey making up 15%. A legend is provided to match the labels to their corresponding colors and patterns, and the percentage labels are placed directly on the slices. The slices in both charts are arranged in a particular order, with the largest slice first, but no slices are visually emphasized.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt zwei Kreisdiagramme, die die Verteilung der mit dem Wort "Reaktion" assoziierten Wörter in den Bereichen Chemie (a) und Mathematik (b) vergleichen. Beide Diagramme haben insgesamt fünf Segmente, die jeweils eine andere Kategorie darstellen. Diagramm (a) enthält die Segmente "the" (diagonal gestreift, 31%), "this" (horizontal gestreift, 21%), "for" (kariert, 17%), "chemical" (gelb mit Punkten, 15%), und "to" (gelb mit Wellen, 9%) und "in" (vertikal gestreift, 7%). Diagramm (b) enthält die Segmente "the" (diagonal gestreift, 38%), "$" (rot gepunktet,  27%), "equilibrium" (gelb gepunktet, 19%), und "constant" (grau, 15%). Die Prozentsätze sind direkt neben den jeweiligen Segmenten angegeben. Die Segmente sind weder in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge angeordnet noch sind bestimmte Segmente hervorgehoben. Die Legende befindet sich oberhalb der jeweiligen Diagramme.
